_note:
V20 "Falcon Jet" sizing at both scales: masses and CG, hover and motor-out power, cruise drag and power,
mission energy, the transition corridor, and stability/trim from tools/v20/aero.py.

    python3 tools/v20/sizing.py          # analysis/v20_sizing.json (+ printed summary)

Mini (scale 0.1): a component build-up of real hobby parts (reference candidates in docs/V20_FALCON_JET.md),
plus printed skins from the generated surfaces at a measured-later areal density.
Full (scale 1.0): a closed sizing loop - pilot, battery from the mission energy, lift/cruise propulsion from
the hover and motor-out power, structure from the wetted areas at composite areal densities, systems.

Everything here is a screening model (momentum theory with figures of merit, flat-plate drag build-up,
linear vortex lattice). It is good for comparing options and for finding what dominates; it is not a
substitute for thrust-stand data, a structural analysis or flight test.

items: EDF thrust tube + nozzle liner (0.2 mm PET film)
intake ducts (0.2 mm PET film, two)
GPS + compass (M10), under the front of the canopy
servo x2 ruddervators (5 g digital, in the dorsal spine)
servo x2 bottom louvres / exit vanes (5 g, one per side, front + rear linked)
top louvre hinge wires + elastic closers (suction-opened)
linkages, horns, hinges, 2 mm ruddervator pivot rods
carbon tubes: 6 mm main spar (2 halves), 4 mm centre spar
fixed tricycle gear (wire legs, foam wheels)
payload module: 4K action camera (RunCam Thumb 2 class) on a 5 g tilt servo, window door
flight-control computers (triplex), air data, AHRS, radios, displays
lift inverters x8 (aft body behind the main spar)
lift fans, hubs, pitch-fixed blades x8
thrust tube to the nozzle (hot-section liner behind the turbine)
turbogenerator (turboshaft + generator + rectifier), in the nose
turbine exhaust pipes (2, insulated) beside the cockpit to the thrust tube

hybrid.battery_sized_by: CG trim (the pack is the nose weight)
